name: Net-liquidity macro tide gates a crypto risk-on long (Fed BS minus TGA, weekly, T+8)
rationale: Thesis: Fed net liquidity (WALCL minus the Treasury General Account, net_liquidity_usd) is a macro-plumbing 'tide' that retail/CT discuss qualitatively but few systematize as a long-only crypto-spot REGIME GATE. The un-quantified part an LLM bridges: discrete liquidity events (debt-ceiling resolution -> TGA rebuild drains reserves; shutdown -> TGA balloons; QT pace) are calendar/policy-driven, not price-driven, so the tide turns on a clock hedge funds rarely route onto 8 spot alts. BTC is documented as extremely sensitive to liquidity as a non-yield-bearing asset. We ARM a long when net_liquidity_usd CROSSES UP through a fitted threshold (liquidity easing -> the 4-week change is positive expressed as a scale-stable cross event, NOT a raw drifting level) AND macro_regime is above a fitted risk-off floor (not in its risk-off extreme). We go flat when net_liquidity_usd crosses DOWN (tide receding) or macro_regime drops below the risk-off floor. Net liquidity is weekly and knowable ~T+8, so the gate flips rarely -> naturally low turnover (10bps taker fee survivable). DISCONFIRMERS: (1) Control arm replaces net_liquidity_usd with the raw fed_balance_sheet_usd LEVEL via the SAME cross op — if an always-rising balance-sheet level reproduces the edge it is a hidden time-trend, not the tide (this is precisely why we use the CROSS/CHANGE on net liquidity, not a level filter). (2) Buy-and-hold over the same windows — the gate MUST beat passive long, else it is just crypto's secular uptrend. (3) Date-shuffle the liquidity series (preserve marginal distribution, break price alignment) — the edge must vanish. Falsified if any disconfirmer matches. tier1 + low-confidence until validated OOS; the Gate down-weights until it earns its place.
catalyst: net_liquidity_usd crosses UP through a fitted easing threshold (liquidity tide rising) while macro_regime is not in its risk-off extreme
